rules.rule_name: Yarn on the Afghanistan duty-drawback negative list
rules.validation_note: Export Policy Order, 2022, Schedule-III (page 18) is the negative list of items for exports to Afghanistan under the duty drawback scheme, made under paragraph 7(3); item 3 reads 'Yarn all types'. This restricts the duty drawback scheme for that destination, not the export itself. CACE cannot determine from the shipment fields whether duty drawback is being claimed, so this is reported for manual review and never as a failure.
